text.en:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Penggalakan Pelaburan
(Perisytiharan Wang Pemegang Syer Berhubungan Dengan Syarikat Kecil Di
Bawah Seksyen 2) (Pindaan) 2013.

 (2) Perintah ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada 3 Julai 2012.

Pindaan perenggan 2

2. Perintah Penggalakan Pelaburan (Pe risytiharan Wan g Pemegang Syer
Berhubungan Dengan Syarikat Kecil -Kecilan Di Bawah Seksyen 2) 1989
[P.U. (A) 83/1989] dipinda dalam perenggan 2 dengan menggantikan perkataan ‘‘lima
ratus ribuˮ dengan perkataan ‘‘dua juta lima ratus ribuˮ.

Dibuat 2 April  2013
[MITI:ID/BDI/G(S)314/3 Jld. 9; PN(PU2)451/VII]

DATO' SRI MUSTAPA MOHAMED
Menteri Perdagangan Antarabangsa dan Industri

PROMOTION OF INVESTMENTS ACT 1986

PROMOTION OF INVESTMENTS (DECLARATION OF SHAREHOLDERS' FUNDS IN
RELATION TO A SMALL SCALE COMPANY UNDER SECTION 2) (AMENDMENT)
ORDER 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Promotion of Investments Act
1986 [Act 327], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

         (2)      This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 3 July 2012.

Amendment of paragraph 2
2. The Promotion of Investments (Declaration Of Shareholders' Funds In Relation
To a Small Scale Company Under Section 2)  Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 83/1989] is amended
in paragraph 2 by substituting for the words ‘‘five hundred thousandˮ the words ‘‘two
million five hundred thousandˮ.

Made 2 April 2013
[MITI:ID/BDI/G(S)314/3 Jld. 9; PN(PU2)451/VII]

DATO' SRI MUSTAPA MOHAMED
Minister of International Trade and Industry

1.    (1)    This order may be cited as the Promotion of Investments (Declaration Of
Shareholders' Funds In Relation To a Small Scale Company Under Section 2)
(Amendment) Order 2013.
